## Purpose
`useFullscreen(ref)`: full screen for one element. It uses the Fullscreen API, falling back to covering the window when that is unavailable or refused.

## Responsibilities
- Tracks native mode through `fullscreenchange`.
- In fallback mode, Escape exits.
- `toggle()` exits whichever mode is active, else tries `requestFullscreen`, else switches to the fallback.
- Returns `{isFullscreen, isFallback, toggle}`.

## Key elements
`useFullscreen`.

## Control flow
React effects.

## Data, state and side effects
Document listeners.

## Configuration
None.

## Interactions
- **Used by:** the graph and canvas views.

## Error handling and edge cases
- A refused request falls through to the fallback.

## Nuances and gotchas
Embedded frames and some mobile browsers refuse the native API.
